verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-15) but there is no mention of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file or endpoint, and a direct probe for a machine-readable spec (llms.txt) returned a 404. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or endpoint (e.g., /openapi.json) providing a machine-readable API spec, and any confirmation it can be downloaded.
